scripts.dev: concurrently -n "infra,mcp-server,webapp" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:infra" "npm run dev:mcp-server" "npm run dev:webapp"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.rebuild: npm run build && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && node scripts/wait-for-db.js
